name: Containers

local_evidence.scope: Deterministic digest-pinned OCI context packaging and tamper inspection only; no local image build or execution.

hosted_execution.proof_step_name: Build twice and reproduce in OCI
hosted_execution.public_page_observation: Public job page reports success on October 23, 2026 in 1m 5s; sign-in is required to view logs.

zero_exit_requires: Resolve immutable base and builder addresses.
Perform two independent no-cache Buildx builds.
Accept the config or manifest digest as Docker's reported image ID.
Execute six valid and hostile cases and require exact container-versus-host result equality.
Set reproduced=true and identical_second_environment=true only after all cases pass.
proof_contract.cleanup: Disposable Buildx builder is removed in finally; report.json is written even on failure.

artifact.name: owned-oci-capability-evidence
artifact.digest_boundary: Archive metadata SHA-256 is not an OCI image digest and does not prove report, case, or layout contents.

overall_canonical_ci.negative_evidence: Job 1, Kernel and organ tests, was cancelled after its timeout; the OCI success does not convert that cancellation into success.

negative_evidence_retained: Earlier Docker 29 Buildx attempt failed; later success does not erase that history.
Artifact archive and raw logs were not locally inspected; public logs require sign-in and the log API requires repository admin rights.
No independent reviewer has inspected report.json, per-case outputs, OCI layouts, or a hosted image digest.
Full GREG/organ images, stronger general-code execution, live activation, full-machine portability, and deployment remain unproven.

completion_boundary.capability: Restricted-rule OCI context packaging with exact-head hosted independent-rebuild and second-environment evidence.
completion_boundary.stronger_evidence_requires: Inspect the immutable artifact and raw logs, or commission a fresh independent proof exposing equivalent case-level evidence.
